before_conditions: The protocol has epochs, and rewards for an epoch are claimable only for the previous epoch (currentEpoch - 1).
Reward eligibility for an epoch is determined by the user's bonded balance at the exact end timestamp of that epoch.
The end timestamp of the previous epoch is exactly the same as the start timestamp of the new epoch.
An attacker has capital available to deposit into the protocol.
Honest users have locked deposits during the epoch and are eligible for rewards.
required_property: Rewards for an epoch should be distributed proportionally to the time-weighted locked deposits of users throughout that entire epoch, ensuring that only users who bore liquidity risk for the full epoch receive a fair share, and preventing users who deposit only at the epoch boundary from diluting honest users' rewards.
bad_outcome: An attacker can deposit capital at the exact boundary of an epoch (right before it ends), instantly claim a massive share of the rewards for that epoch, and severely dilute the rewards of honest users who held their deposits for the entire epoch.
